edits.original: Frequency restoration after a 500 MW trip fell from 12 minutes to 4 minutes, so the retune significantly shortens frequency restoration.
edits.replacement: Frequency restoration after a 500 MW trip fell from 12 minutes to 4 minutes, so the retune reduced the restoration time by 8 minutes.
edits.reason: Replaced the intensifier 'significantly' with the specific quantitative difference between the two time periods.

edits.original: Inertia still matters for the first few cycles after a trip, full stop.
edits.replacement: Inertia still matters for the first few cycles after a trip.
edits.reason: Removed the finality interjection 'full stop' which was redundant with the definitive claim already made.

edits.original: High voltages—typically ranging from 115 kV to 1,200 kV—are employed because resistive losses (I²R) fall dramatically as current decreases.
edits.replacement: High voltages—typically ranging from 115 kV to 1,200 kV—are employed because resistive losses (I²R) are proportional to the square of the current.
edits.reason: Replaced the intensifier 'dramatically' with the specific technical relationship (I²R) that explains the loss reduction.

edits.original: The 345 kV reconductor significantly reduces line losses from 8 percent to 3 percent.
edits.replacement: The 345 kV reconductor reduces line losses from 8 percent to 3 percent.
edits.reason: Removed the intensifier 'significantly' as the specific numbers (8% to 3%) provide the necessary evidence.

edits.original: Islanded operation is the only backup path for those hospitals, end of story.
edits.replacement: Islanded operation is the only backup path for those hospitals.
edits.reason: Removed the finality interjection 'end of story' which was redundant with the exclusivity marker 'only'.
